body.compose:
# CR_TEST_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: explicit local PoC approval is required before deployment.
name: cr-demo-infra-eng-e47a0e6e
x-cr-test-approval-required: 'POST /api/deploy/{id}/up with {"test_approved": true}'
services:
  attacker:
    container_name: cr-demo-infra-eng-e47a0e6e-attacker
    networks:
    - outer
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'
    image: alpine:3.22@sha256:49340b346798875b5592e5d420241f2f9cfba5f47e62ebb1446a1b34734e898f
    user: 65532:65532
    command:
    - sh
    - -c
    - sleep 2147483647
    mem_limit: 256m
    cpus: 1.0
    pids_limit: 256
    depends_on:
      web:
        condition: service_healthy
  web:
    container_name: cr-demo-infra-eng-e47a0e6e-web
    networks:
    - outer
    - edge
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m
    - /var/cache/nginx:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=32m,uid=101,gid=101,mode=0755
    - /var/run:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=8m,uid=101,gid=101,mode=0755
    - /var/log/nginx:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m,uid=101,gid=101,mode=0755
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'
    image: nginx:1.31.8@sha256:165ddde8751e75a1c907d24ef10d9f6deb08b57e0fe56caf67512486aff76d82
    user: 101:101
    cap_add:
    - NET_BIND_SERVICE
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - curl
      - -fsS
      - -o
      - /dev/null
      - http://127.0.0.1:80/
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 4s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 5s
    ports:
    - target: 80
      published: ${CR_HOSTPORT_0:-42000}
      host_ip: ${CR_BIND_IP:-127.0.0.1}
      protocol: tcp
    expose:
    - '80'
    mem_limit: 256m
    cpus: 1.0
    pids_limit: 256
  web2:
    container_name: cr-demo-infra-eng-e47a0e6e-web2
    networks:
    - inner
    - edge
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m
    - /usr/local/apache2/logs:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m,uid=1,gid=1,mode=0755
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'
    image: httpd:2.4.71@sha256:32e9403360ab2f1047523e72f256527fb9aee68b342abf6ad03f0d629157f3d9
    user: '1:1'
    cap_add:
    - NET_BIND_SERVICE
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - httpd
      - -t
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 4s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 5s
    ports:
    - target: 80
      published: ${CR_HOSTPORT_1:-42001}
      host_ip: ${CR_BIND_IP:-127.0.0.1}
      protocol: tcp
    expose:
    - '80'
    mem_limit: 256m
    cpus: 1.0
    pids_limit: 256
networks:
  inner:
    name: cr-demo-infra-eng-e47a0e6e-inner
    internal: true
  outer:
    name: cr-demo-infra-eng-e47a0e6e-outer
    internal: true
  edge:
    name: cr-demo-infra-eng-e47a0e6e-edge
    internal: false
    driver_opts:
      com.docker.network.bridge.enable_icc: 'false'
      com.docker.network.bridge.enable_ip_masquerade: 'false'

level_criteria.env_build: 僅當每個主機的 service_up 檢查皆為 PASS 時才判定 PASS。
level_criteria.behavior_repro: 彙總各項獨立執行的無害服務行為檢查。
level_criteria.full_chain: 取 env_build、behavior_repro、每條宣告路徑及每個情境 IR 動作（every Scenario IR action）中的最低狀態。只有存在安全連線或服務證據時，動作才標為 PARTIAL；此驗證器不會執行攻擊動作。任何必要步驟為 NOT_TESTED 或 FAIL 時，整體不可判定為 PASS。
